sidebar: Scope: weekend prototype: 3 days, the core loop only
Session: open-ended and ambient (left running, checked on now and then)
Setting: a paper city folded from old letters
Twist: light is the only currency
description: You are a quiet keeper of a paper city that grows one letter at a time. You decide which threads to follow, what to brew, and how your collection reads, so the unfolding tale is unmistakably yours — no other player would build it the same way.
